name: io.github.Webb-Ventures/autorouter
title: autorouter
description: An MCP capability router: one search tool instead of every server's tool schema.

environmentVariables.name: AUTOROUTER_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to autorouter.json. Defaults to the standard lookup chain (./.autorouter.json, ~/.config/autorouter/config.json, …).

environmentVariables.name: AUTOROUTER_IMPORT
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated harness configs to import: claude, codex, cursor, vscode, plugins.

environmentVariables.name: AUTOROUTER_SELECTOR_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Reranker backend: auto | sampling | cli | api | off.

environmentVariables.name: AUTOROUTER_SELECTOR_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model the selector reranks with, e.g. haiku.
